name: Food Oil Can
tagline: A squat wide oil can sample modeled in 3D from the supplied product photos and dimensions card.
description: A wide rounded-rectangle oil can sample with an offset fluted screw cap, asymmetric moulded handle, big oval finger opening, raised top shoulder, and grip ribs on the narrow side faces. The interactive 3D model follows the supplied photo set and dimensions card, including the short-and-wide jug orientation. Verified supplier composition and food-contact data are still in progress, so no LIMEX percentage, mechanical values, or CO2 figures are published for this product.
